description:
COACTUPC ENTER cold start - the fifty-four-field contract baseline every other COACTUPC screen case is a perturbation of. EIBCALEN is 0, so the FIRST disjunct of the commarea gate at app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:880-882 is true and :883-886 INITIALIZEs CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, SETs CDEMO-PGM-ENTER and SETs ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED - so no commarea travelled and none of the ELSE at :887-892 runs. EIBAID is DFHENTER, so YYYY-STORE-PFKEY at :898-899 yields CCARD-AID-ENTER, the validity gate at :904-916 accepts it as PFK-VALID and the IF PFK-INVALID remap at :914-916 does not fire. The order-sensitive EVALUATE TRUE at :919 - arms :925 CCARD-AID-PFK03, :963 ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED AND CDEMO-PGM-ENTER, :977 ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE / ACUP-CHANGES-FAILED, :994 OTHER - lands on the SECOND arm, which INITIALIZEs WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, performs 3000-SEND-MAP through the benign range PERFORM at :968-969, SETs CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at :970, SETs ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED at :971 and leaves by the forward-only GO TO COMMON-RETURN at :972. 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS and 2000-DECIDE-ACTION are NEVER performed on this path, so nothing is edited, no field is highlighted and no file verb runs. COMMON-RETURN :1007-1020 then MOVEs WS-RETURN-MSG to CCARD-ERROR-MSG, packs CARDDEMO-COMMAREA followed immediately by WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA into WS-COMMAREA and ends at EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(LIT-THISTRANID) - Termination RETURN_TRANSID, never XCTL. THE SCREEN, composed from the five rules 3000-SEND-MAP applies, each traceable to one paragraph: (1) 3100-SCREEN-INIT :2670 MOVEs LOW-VALUES TO CACTUPAO, so every one of the fifty-four xxxO items starts as x'00' at the width its xxxI item declares in app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY - rendered here as literal U+0000 characters, one per byte, because FieldDiffer compares bytes and LOW-VALUES is neither spaces nor a zero-filled edit mask; (2) :2672-2691 assigns the six header items - TITLE01O and TITLE02O from CCDA-TITLE01 and the ACTIVE CCDA-TITLE02 at app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:18-19 and :22 (:21 is commented out), TRNNAMEO from LIT-THISTRANID :535-536, PGMNAMEO from LIT-THISPGM :533-534, and CURDATEO mm/dd/yy with CURTIMEO hh:mm:ss from FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE; (3) 3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS :2700-2703 takes the CDEMO-PGM-ENTER CONTINUE branch, so NOT ONE data field is assigned and ACCTSIDO stays LOW-VALUES rather than blank - the single most plausible place to go wrong here, and the reason the five monetary items ACRDLIMO, ACSHLIMO, ACURBALO, ACRCYCRO and ACRCYDBO are x'00' and not an edited zero; (4) 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG :2957-2958 SETs PROMPT-FOR-SEARCH-KEYS on its first arm, then :2979 MOVEs WS-INFO-MSG - PIC X(40) holding the 39-character literal at :468-469 - into INFOMSGO PIC X(45), which right-space-pads it to 45, and :2981 MOVEs WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75), still SPACES from SET WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF at :876, into ERRMSGO PIC X(78) as 78 spaces; (5) FKEYSO, FKEY05O and FKEY12O are the mapset's own INITIAL text at app/bms/COACTUP.bms:493-507 and are never assigned by the program at all - 3390-SETUP-INFOMSG-ATTRS reveals or hides them by attribute. THE ATTRIBUTE PLANES are the fifty-four xxxC colour items and fifty-four xxxH highlight items. No field fails validation here, so every colour is the default DFHDFCOL: this is the OK/ENTER corner of the error-highlight matrix and the negative half of the entry-versus-re-entry contract (gate G38), because CSSETATY's DFHRED plus '*' highlight is guarded by CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and the context is still ENTER while 3300 runs. Every highlight is the default DFHDFHI except INFOMSGH, which 3390-SETUP-INFOMSG-ATTRS :3567-3571 sets to DFHBMASB because WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is false - there IS an information message. The xxxA items 3310-PROTECT-ALL-ATTRS :3441-3492 and :3000 write - DFHBMPRF into fifty of them and then DFHBMFSE into ACCTSIDA - are deliberately NOT declared: they are items of the INPUT redefine CACTUPAI, not of the sent CACTUPAO, and ScreenSend.attributes admits only the output planes whose names end in C, P, H or V. DFHBMSCA publishes no mnemonic table for a programmed-symbol or validation byte, so xxxP and xxxV are not named either. THE CURSOR is ACCTSIDL. 3300's cursor EVALUATE at :3009 is order-sensitive: FOUND-ACCOUNT-DATA is false because 3250 has already left WS-INFO-MSG holding the search-key prompt rather than 'Details of selected account shown above', and NO-CHANGES-DETECTED is false because WS-RETURN-MSG is SPACES, so the second arm wins on FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK - WS-EDIT-ACCT-FLAG is a space after INITIALIZE WS-MISC-STORAGE at :867 and the 88 at :186 is VALUE ' ' - and :3015 MOVEs -1 TO ACCTSIDL. COBOL positions the cursor by moving -1 into a symbolic-map length item, so the xxxL item IS the cursor; ACCTSIDL is named for that reason and is not a payload field. STATELESSNESS (rule R6, gate G37): every scrap of conversation state travels in the payload and none of it is held server-side. The inbound state is screenRequest - EIBCALEN 0, the DFHENTER AID, an empty commarea because none travelled, and no received map field. The outbound state is the sixteen CARDDEMO-COMMAREA fields of navigation, where CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT is 1: :970 SETs CDEMO-PGM-REENTER BEFORE the return, so the context that leaves is the NEXT turn's, not this one's. ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION stays in its ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED state - x'00' or a space per the 88 at :656-658 - and travels in WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, which COMMON-RETURN :1011-1012 places immediately after the 160-byte CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; navigation compares that shared 160-byte image only, which is why the program's own extension is not pinned there. CCARD-ERROR-MSG is 75 spaces from :1008. NOTHING IS WRITTEN. COACTUPC's file verbs are the reads at :3656 and :3705 and the read-for-update and rewrite pairs inside 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING, and this path reaches none of them, so expectedWrites is empty as a POSITIVE assertion and each of the four seeded rows is pinned unchanged on the final-state channel as the other half of it. The rows are the coherent slice for ACCT-ID 00000000001: acctdata.txt row 0, custdata.txt row 0 (CUST-ID 000000001), and carddata.txt and cardxref.txt row 48, which is the cross-reference and card for that account. cardxref.txt is seeded RAW at 36 bytes and is NOT pre-padded here: CVACT03Y declares 50 and the fixture omits the trailing FILLER X(14), so the declared CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation supplies the fourteen spaces once, at seed time, and the final-state image is asserted at the copybook's 50 (gate G16). Pre-padding the input would double-pad it. RETURN CODE 0. COACTUPC never sets a COBOL RETURN-CODE - the identifier does not occur anywhere in its 4,236 lines - because it is pseudo-conversational and ends at EXEC CICS RETURN. expectedMessages is empty, and that is a positive statement rather than an omission: every message write in this program is guarded by IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF and none fires here, so no DISPLAY line and no WS-MESSAGE is produced. The information text is not a message channel either - MessageChannel publishes DISPLAY_LINE, WS_MESSAGE_80 and SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 and no 45-byte channel exists - so it is pinned byte-exactly where the program actually put it, in INFOMSGO at its declared 45, alongside ERRMSGO at its declared 78. NO ARITHMETIC IS REACHED, so no scale and no rounding mode applies: the five COMPUTE sites at :1079, :1093, :1107, :1121 and :1135 all live inside 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, which this arm never performs. Where COACTUPC does compute, ROUNDED appears zero times in it and in all twenty-eight programs, so the receiver's PIC S9(10)V99 scale of 2 is reached by truncation - RoundingMode.DOWN, never HALF_UP or HALF_EVEN - but no such value appears in this case. Every record image and every screen value here is US-ASCII, named explicitly and never the platform default (practice B8). TWO GATES ARE NOT APPLICABLE and are recorded as such rather than silently skipped. G32 does not apply: COACTUPC's fifty-one GO TOs all target an -EXIT label, COMMON-RETURN or a forward stage, and CBSTM03A is the only program in the migration whose GO TOs form implicit loops. G35 does not apply: CALL 'CEE3ABD' occurs zero times in COACTUPC - the nine sites are all in batch programs - and its only abnormal exit is the EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999') reached from ABEND-ROUTINE, which the HANDLE ABEND at :862-864 arms but which nothing on this path can trigger. PROVENANCE (practice B12): every expected value above was derived STATICALLY, by structured reading of app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:533-541, :463-480, :859-1020, :2649-2703, :2955-2983, :2986-3016, :3441-3496, :3566-3584 and :3589-3603, cross-checked against the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions and INITIAL text of app/bms/COACTUP.bms, the commarea layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the titles in app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, the copybook byte layouts CVACT01Y 300 / CVCUS01Y 500 / CVACT02Y 150 / CVACT03Y 50, and the real fixtures in app/data/ASCII. It was NEVER captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: executing it is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository - and this static derivation is the recorded substitute for an execution baseline, escalated as risk R-A rather than silently absorbed. THREE AUTHORING NOTES, recorded rather than left to be inferred. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:15:59, which is this source revision's own timestamp - every file carries 'Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19 23:15:5x CDT', COTTL01Y.cpy:26 among them - so CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are fixed literals and no wall clock can reach the expectation (practice B7); a near-present date would have been equally deterministic but would have diverged from every other fixture in this tree and from COACTUPCParityTest's own PINNED_CLOCK. The payload items are keyed by their symbolic OUTPUT names - TRNNAMEO through FKEY12O - because a sent map carries CACTUPAO and ScreenSend.fields admits only xxxO items; the xxxL, xxxF and xxxA metadata items appear nowhere in this file except ACCTSIDL as the cursor, which is where COBOL expresses a cursor. And COACTUPCParityTest currently declares its twenty scenarios in Java rather than loading them from this directory, allocating case01 to an AccountUpdateService concurrency check and this same cold-start screen to its case15; the divergence in NUMBERING is recorded here rather than resolved by inventing a different scenario, because the scenario itself - unit kind CONTROLLER_POJO, AccountUpdateController constructed directly and its handler called as a plain method with no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path (gate G51) - is what this case is specified to pin.

OBSERVATION SCOPE, STATED SO IT CANNOT BE MISREAD AS AN OMISSION. COACTUPC contains no DISPLAY verb - no CICS program does - so this case declares no DISPLAY_LINE and no SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 message. WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at :479 leaves the program through MOVE WS-RETURN-MSG TO ERRMSGO OF CACTUPAO at :2981 followed by EXEC CICS SEND MAP, and ERRMSGO is pinned byte for byte inside expectedResponse.sends at its declared PIC X(78) width. Declaring it a second time on a message channel would make one difference report as two and would invent an emission the program does not perform. The eighty-byte WS-DATE-VALIDATION-RESULT of each CALL 'CSUTLDTC' (app/cpy/CSUTLDPY.cpy:293 into app/cpy/CSUTLDWY.cpy:60-85) IS declared, on the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel and in call order, because nothing in the response exposes it and its count is itself an assertion about how far the edit chain ran.

fields.INFOMSGO: Enter or update id of account to update
